symbols.name: Gaussian dyadic number
symbols.meaning: A complex number whose real and imaginary parts are both dyadic rationals.
symbols.quote: A Gaussian dyadic number is a complex number $z = a + bi$ whose real part $a$ and imaginary part $b$ are both dyadic rationals, that is, rationals $m/2^k$ with $m$ an integer and $k \ge 0$.

symbols.name: real part
symbols.meaning: The real part of the Gaussian dyadic number $z$, a dyadic rational.
symbols.quote: A Gaussian dyadic number is a complex number $z = a + bi$ whose real part $a$ and imaginary part $b$ are both dyadic rationals, that is, rationals $m/2^k$ with $m$ an integer and $k \ge 0$.

symbols.name: imaginary part
symbols.meaning: The imaginary part of the Gaussian dyadic number $z$, a dyadic rational.
symbols.quote: A Gaussian dyadic number is a complex number $z = a + bi$ whose real part $a$ and imaginary part $b$ are both dyadic rationals, that is, rationals $m/2^k$ with $m$ an integer and $k \ge 0$.

symbols.name: integer numerator
symbols.meaning: The integer numerator of a dyadic rational written as $m/2^k$.
symbols.quote: A Gaussian dyadic number is a complex number $z = a + bi$ whose real part $a$ and imaginary part $b$ are both dyadic rationals, that is, rationals $m/2^k$ with $m$ an integer and $k \ge 0$.

symbols.name: power-of-two exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent $k \ge 0$ such that $2^k$ is the denominator of a dyadic rational $m/2^k$.
symbols.quote: A Gaussian dyadic number is a complex number $z = a + bi$ whose real part $a$ and imaginary part $b$ are both dyadic rationals, that is, rationals $m/2^k$ with $m$ an integer and $k \ge 0$.

symbols.name: Gaussian dyadic set
symbols.meaning: The set of all Gaussian dyadic numbers.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathcal{G}$ for the set of these numbers.

symbols.name: butterfly map
symbols.meaning: The map sending a pair $(u,v)$ to $((u+v)/2, (u-v)/2)$.
symbols.quote: The butterfly layer applies a map $H_0(u,v) = ((u+v)/2, (u-v)/2)$ to pairs $u, v$ of values.

symbols.name: first butterfly input
symbols.meaning: The first value of an input pair to the butterfly map $H_0$.
symbols.quote: The butterfly layer applies a map $H_0(u,v) = ((u+v)/2, (u-v)/2)$ to pairs $u, v$ of values.

symbols.name: second butterfly input
symbols.meaning: The second value of an input pair to the butterfly map $H_0$.
symbols.quote: The butterfly layer applies a map $H_0(u,v) = ((u+v)/2, (u-v)/2)$ to pairs $u, v$ of values.

symbols.name: fractional bit count
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional bits in each stored part, so every stored part is a multiple of $2^{-p}$.
symbols.quote: Each stored part is a multiple of $2^{-p}$, where $p$ is the number of fractional bits.
